purpose: Develop distinct BULL, RANGE and BEAR exit state machines. Fixed 6h/12h/24h exits remain comparison baselines and maximum-hold backstops only.

validation_design.note: The entry model predates these exit tests. The 2026 block is untouched only with respect to the R1 exit-policy candidate selection, not the entry model.

common_execution_semantics.fixed_stop_target_from_legacy_p10: candidate inputs only; not automatically inherited

BULL.economic_mechanism: Trend pullback. Cut a confirmed failed pullback, take a first tranche into impulse recovery, and trail the residual while the trend continues.

RANGE.economic_mechanism: Mean reversion. Exit at the statistical mean rather than carrying a range trade as a trend position; cut only a confirmed range break or hard adverse excursion.

BEAR.economic_mechanism: Capitulation rebound long. Require fast recovery realization; cut a failed rebound/new low earlier than a normal range trade and do not carry indefinitely in structural weakness.

selection_rule: Per lane, among candidates passing every gate choose highest worst-block mean net bps, then lowest full-sample max drawdown, then highest worst-block PF, then lexical key.
release_rule: No production integration unless all three lane policies pass, a generated immutable config is committed, and Python-to-TypeScript golden parity passes.
